g.title: CDI_QSP
g.text: Clostridioides difficile Infection — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
dysbiosis → bile-acid permissive niche → spore germination → PaLoc toxin output → barrier failure → recurrence
20 mechanistic modules · 236 nodes · states carried in cdi_mrgsolve_model.R are drawn with a double border

g.title: cluster_abx
g.text: 2. Precipitating antibiotic — spectrum determines the size of the hole

g.title: cluster_mb
g.text: 3. Colonic microbiota guilds — the substrate of colonization resistance

g.title: cluster_ba
g.text: 4. Enterohepatic + microbial bile-acid metabolism (the germination switch)

g.title: cluster_nut
g.text: 5. Luminal nutrient niche liberated by dysbiosis

g.title: cluster_scfa
g.text: 6. SCFA axis — barrier support and virulence damping

g.title: cluster_cd
g.text: 7. C. difficile life cycle — germination, outgrowth, sporulation, biofilm

g.title: cluster_paloc
g.text: 9. PaLoc (19.6 kb) transcriptional control of toxin output

g.title: cluster_tox
g.text: 10. TcdA / TcdB — receptor binding, autoprocessing, Rho-GTPase glucosylation

g.title: cluster_cdt
g.text: 11. Binary toxin CDT and hypervirulent ribotypes

g.title: cluster_epi
g.text: 12. Colonic epithelium — barrier failure, secretion, stem-cell arrest

g.title: cluster_inn
g.text: 13. Innate immune response and pseudomembrane formation

g.title: cluster_adapt
g.text: 14. Adaptive anti-toxin immunity — the determinant of carriage vs recurrence

g.title: cluster_abpk
g.text: 16. Anti-C. difficile antibacterials — colonic PK and PD

g.title: cluster_rest
g.text: 17. Microbiome restoration — treating the hole rather than the organism

g.title: DR_MTZ_COL
g.text: colonic metronidazole — falls as mucosa heals

g.title: ABX_FQ
g.text: (highest OR; also selects gyrA T82I RT027)

g.title: MB_SBA
g.text: C. scindens · C. hiranonis · Clostridia XIVa

g.title: DR_KILL
g.text: total bactericidal pressure on C. difficile

g.title: DR_SER
g.text: SER-109 / VOWST oral purified Firmicutes spores

g.title: DR_TOLEV
g.text: (failed phase 3 — proof the toxin alone isn't enough)

g.title: LG_1
g.text: double border = ODE state in cdi_mrgsolve_model.R (61 compartments)

g.title: LG_2
g.text: octagon = drug / intervention · hexagon = clinical endpoint
diamond = regulatory switch or derived rate

g.title: LG_3
g.text: green tee-arrow = protective inhibition of a harmful node

g.title: LG_4
g.text: The recurrence loop is the model's organising principle:
CD_SPORE_B survives therapy, MB_SBA does not recover before the drug stops,
BA_TCA stays high and BA_DCA stays low → CD_GERM re-fires.

g.title: LG_5
g.text: Calibration anchors: Louie 2011 & Cornely 2012 (fidaxomicin vs vancomycin),
Feuerstadt 2022 ECOSPOR III (SER-109), Khanna 2022 PUNCH CD3 (RBX2660),
Guery 2018 EXTEND, Johnson 2014 (metronidazole vs vancomycin), Kyne 2001 (anti-toxin IgG).

g.title: LG_6
g.text: Two therapeutic axes are structurally distinct in the model:
Only the second changes the recurrence probability.
